one_sentence: This document argues that the human soul can be formally modeled as a massless scalar field obeying the Klein-Gordon equation, with death as decoupling and resurrection as re-coupling.
executive_summary: This document proposes an isomorphism between a real scalar field (Psi_S) obeying the Klein-Gordon equation and the Christian theological concept of the soul. The core structural claim is that the soul field is massless (m_S ~ 0), implying immortality, and couples to matter via a Yukawa interaction with an extremely small coupling constant (g_sm ~ 10^(-18) to 10^(-15)). Death is modeled as the decoupling of this interaction (g_sm -> 0), not the destruction of the field (Psi_S -> 0), while resurrection is re-coupling. The model also posits a conserved soul number N_S. The document includes an honest assessment that this is the most speculative ISO in the registry, noting zero experimental evidence, suspiciously convenient parameter choices, and the fact that the Klein-Gordon equation is generic and does not capture the moral or relational aspects of the soul. It concludes that this is mathematical theology, not physics, and should remain undetermined until testable predictions unique to Psi_S are made.
short_summary: This document is an isomorphism record (ISO-014) that models the human soul as a massless scalar field in quantum field theory. The core structural claim is that the soul field obeys the Klein-Gordon equation, with death as decoupling and resurrection as re-coupling of a Yukawa interaction. Key evidence includes the mathematical properties of massless fields (non-decaying, infinite Compton wavelength) and the conservation of soul number N_S. This matters because it provides a formal language for theological claims about the soul's immortality and intermediate state, but the document honestly acknowledges it is unfalsifiable and speculative.
